beats.headline: Do your work. Let go of the result.
beats.narration: Krishna's most famous teaching is just four lines long.
कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन । मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि ॥

beats.headline: Your right is to the action alone.
beats.subtext: Never to its fruits. Don't act for the reward, and don't cling to inaction.
beats.narration: You have a right to your actions, but never to their fruits. Don't act for the reward, and don't cling to doing nothing.
